notes: A third always on row: Auto Move. It holds your forward key, usually W, so you walk without holding it down yourself. It sits with Auto Attack and Auto Loot in the panel under your ten hotkey slots, it is never one of them, and it arrives switched off so nothing moves until you tick it. Because it holds the key rather than tapping it, F8 is how you stand still. If you already had a row of your own set up to move forward, the app moves it into the new row and keeps your key, your mode and whether it was on, so there is nothing to set up again.
